# Angry Cactus — Not Cute Coloring

Adult coloring artwork in a punk, dark and urban style.
Free sample: /cactus_free_samples.zip (3 PNG/JPG images).
Product and marketplace links: /product.json.
Contact: eddyflores100@gmail.com.

Purchases take place on external marketplaces. Confirm the current price, included files, payment methods, availability and delivery there. This website does not process payments, deliver paid purchases or promise affiliate earnings.

/api/mcp.json is static metadata, not an MCP transport or executable tool server. The contact form prepares an email; the visitor must send it manually.
